typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	 H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID AS [Case ID] 	,CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_AGENT AS AGENT_ID 	,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME + \' \' + M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME as [MEMBER_NAME] 	,M.MEMBER_BIRTH_DT as [Member DOB] 	,DATEFROMPARTS(CONVERT(INT,LEFT(H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE,4)),CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE),5,2)),CONVERT(INT,RIGHT(H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE,2))) AS [Case_Creation_date] 	,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD as [SCRUB_RULE_CD] 	,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC as [SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION] 	,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD as DISPOSITIONCODE 	,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION FROM  	 PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID            	INNER JOIN  		( 			   SELECT MAX(CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID  			   FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'137\'  					  AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID 		) MAXCD ON  CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID =MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID	                INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID        INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID                   INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID        INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID 	   LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID 			  AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID 	   LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	Where CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'137\' 	AND  	(case when H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CM_PROGRAM=\'PDM\' Then ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD END NOT IN (\'BADPHONE\',\'MAXBADPHONE\') 	OR 	case when H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CM_PROGRAM=\'CCM\' Then 1 END =1 )',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Case_ID as string,
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		AGENT_ID as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		Member_DOB as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SCRUB_RULE_CD as string,
		Case_Creation_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Case_ID = {Case ID},
		MEMBER_NAME,
		AGENT_ID,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		Member_DOB = {Member DOB},
		SCRUB_RULE_CD,
		Case_Creation_date,
		SCRUB_RULE_DESCRIPTION,
		DISPOSITIONCODE)) ~> FlatFileDestination
